articleTitle: Cough Detection System using TinyML
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In this research paper, a system for the detection of cough is made with Edge Impulse Studio and Arduino 33 BLE Sense. It is able to distinguish between actual cough and a general undesired signal in the background. Edge Impulse Studio has been utilized in this article for training a large dataset of the various samples for cough as well as undesired noise. A highly efficient & machine learning based TinyML model is designed for determining the resonance of Cough on instantaneous basis. The proposed system has been found to achieve almost 97% accuracy of recognition.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition using BiLSTM Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Human emotions are play a vital role in work locations and clinical studies. Speech emotion recognition (SER) is easy for humans and it is bit difficult for machines like computers and robots. These systems are unable to identify emotion of a user and are unable to react to their feelings. To improve human-machine interaction, a deep learning (DL) based approach is proposed. This paper presents a SER system using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM). Features such as Gamma tone & Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (GTCC & MFCC) are extracted for SER. Ability of proposed DL approach is observed at different noisy conditions, testing rates and with EMO-DB data set.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Detection using Faster RCNN Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Object recognition and detection has been a crucial need in every field of application. Along with detection of object, recognizing them by text is a growing area of research basis for many applications. The main objective of the paper is to use the neural network YOLO V3 (You Only Look Once Version 3) for detection of a plant disease from the image of the affected area. The combination of object detection and text recognition would provide the output with the bounding boxes around the detected object and displays the disease type which are trained with their names and text by using the pre-trained datasets. The Faster RCNN network shows improvement in training and testing times than the traditional CNN and RCNN networks.

articleTitle: Investigation of Channel Estimation Techniques using OFDM with BPSK QPSK and QAM Modulations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In the past years, the growth of mobile communication networks has been depending on the throughput and data rate, these parameters are affected by different kinds of noise such as white noise, Gaussian noise, and ISI (Inter Symbol Interference) which are added in the communication channel. Channel estimation is the major contest to the wide use of 4G cellular networks with OFDM to reduce all kinds of noises. There is rigorous work has been going on to develop reliable, accurate, and efficient channel estimation techniques for different wireless cellular standards. This paper describes the performance of different channel estimation techniques like the Interpolation techniques of Liner, Cubic Spline, and DFT by varying modulation techniques like QPSK, BPSK, and QAM. To identify efficient channel estimation techniques, it is necessary to investigate and compare the working of these systems in different communication environments. Due to the nature of modulating signal in both amplitude and phase, the QAM gives good performance and due to performing of estimation on limited samples by suppressing estimation values to zero for remaining the DFT estimator gives an accurate performance. These methods are compared concerning Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) vs Bit Error Rate (BER).

articleTitle: A Miniaturized UWB Antenna for High Speed Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna with partial ground plane has been designed on FR4 substrate. This UWB antenna is analyzed with Ansys HFSS software and it operates in the frequency range much more beyond the UWB range of 3.1 Gigahertz to 10.6 Gigahertz with the reflection factor ≤ -10 dB and magnitude of VSWR < 2. The designed antenna having size of 35x24x0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> exhibits the good directional radiation characteristics over the entire impedance bandwidth with excellent value of gain. The antenna is found to be suitable for the various high-speed wireless applications.

articleTitle: A Survey on Energy Efficient, Harvesting & Optimization Approaches in IoT system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a ubiquitous modern technology that consists of multiple key components such as sensors, cloud storage, humans, and so on. Sensors, intelligent computing devices, self-powered devices and data storage units form the foundation of an IoT network’s system architecture. The Internet of Things (IoT) aims to combine as much of our world as possible. In current era, everybody and everywhere started to use & deploy the internet enabled services. Such embedded systems, Multimedia Pod casts, Smart Microwave ovens, home appliances, Global positioning systems & Health Monitoring devices called as biochips etc., In order to eventually automate all sectors, IoT provides sophisticated communication (through the internet) between a list of services, systems, or services. The IoT links all conceivable items to interact with one another in order to provide people with a safe environment & comfortable living. According to recent studies, we wm have over 35 billion IoT devices by 2030. However, these vast fields present issues such as a paucity of IP addresses, as well as the development of suitable and functional protocols and environments. The several places where IoT can be deployed like Building and Home Automation, Industrial Applications, Infrastructure Management, Environmental Monitoring, Large Scale Deployments, Medical and Healthcare Systems, Transport Systems, Energy Management. In this arena, energy conservation or consumption is critical for real-time applications that must operate for longer periods of time. This review article examines and surveys the important energy efficiency, energy harvesting, and other tactics that are used in the IoT to achieve optimal energy use. Also, based on its technological classification, the major aims of this survey article are to propose distinctive approaches, particularly for energy saving. Each section category will be covered in its own parametric.

articleTitle: Physical Layer Security using SMO
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Physical Layer Security (PLS) is used to accomplish perfect secure communication between intended network nodes, while the eavesdropper gets zero information. In this paper, a smart antenna technology i.e., Massive multiple-input-multiple-output (mMIMO) and Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) technology is being used to enhance the secrecy performance of a 5G communication network. Small scale Rayleigh fading channels, as well as large scale pathway loss, have to be taken into consideration. An eavesdropper with multiple antennas, an amplify-and-forward (AF) relay with multi antenna has been proposed. Spider Monkey Algorithm (SMO) is used in adding Artificial Noise (AN) for refining secrecy rate. The findings revealed that the suggested technique improves the security and the quality of Wireless communication.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis By Using Modified RNN And A Tree LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In recent times, there has been an exponential growth in the number of complex documents, texts, and user-generated content, mainly through social media, blogs and review websites, etc., that require a deeper understanding of deep learning methods to be able to accurately classify texts. This research work approaches problems of fine-grained sentiment analysis. We explore how the sentiment of the user-generated text can be identified using Deep Learning. This paper contributes sentiment analysis, which aims to extract opinions from the text. E-commerce, social media, and other many online user-generated contents provide a powerful way for collecting people’s thoughts and their feelings towards users or customers. Powerful sentiment analysis helps many businesses with regard to sentiment, so they will understand users’ perceptions of the product. It’s also very helpful for other customers to get reviews of products and get to know about services they offer. Lots of websites provide users with reviews but it’s very difficult to make some decisions from them. Deep Learning sentiment helps to identify the pros and cons of a product. Nowadays Automated sentiment analysis systems are tools for decision-making for many parties. The deep learning algorithms are able to handle complex sequential data and determine non-linear relationships within data. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) are widely used in natural language processing (NLP) because they are very suitable to process variable-length text. Doing Fine-grained sentiment analysis is a challenging task. We use a modified Recurrent Neural Network (Tree-LSTM) for fine-grained analysis. In this work, we provide a brief overview of deep learning classification algorithms and also conclude that Tree-LSTM gives state-of-the-art accuracy for fine-grained sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Effective VM Placement Mechanism in Cloud Computing using Cuckoo Search Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Effective VM placement mechanism is needed for Cloud Computing as incoming flow of tasks were dynamic when they are coming onto cloud console. Incoming requests for any cloud console were large in number then there is a chance of decay in quality of service. Quality of service will be degraded when these number of requests were not properly handled i.e. SLA violations and more number of migrations. Quality of Service will be directly affected by these parameters. Many of the authors addressed these metrics but still there is a chance to improve the VM placement in cloud computing. In this paper, we have used a nature inspired algorithm i.e. cuckoo search to design the VM placement strategy and we have used a threshold value to identify the physical host whet her it is overloaded, under loaded or balanced based on the utilization of CPU. Cloudsim toolkit is used as a simulator to conduct simulation and our proposed mechanism minimizes violation of SLA and there is a great improvement in makespan when it was compared with PSO and GA algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Three Stage Dynamic Comparator with Tail Transistor using 20nm FinFET Technology for ADCs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: According to this article, one of the key disadvantages is excessive power consumption and offset in CMOS based comparators. At scale down technology, CMOS suffers with short channel effect and leakage current. To address these challenges, FinFET technology is used in threestage dynamic comparators instead of traditional circuit designs. The energy efficiency of FinFET-based dynamic comparators is higher than that of CMOS, and the short channel effect and leakage current are decreased. Furthermore, a new design of FinFET-based three stage dynamic comparators with tail transistors was created and simulated using the cadence virtuoso environment. In comparison to three-stage dynamic comparators without tail transistors, the three-stage dynamic comparator with tail transistor in this approach decreases offset, power consumption, and energy consumption. Both the standard three stage dynamic comparators without tail transistor and the modified three stage dynamic comparators with tail transistor are implemented in the same 20nm FinFET technology for easy comparison. According to simulation results, the modified three stage comparator decreases power consumption by 20% it has a 17% energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Prediction of Flight Fare using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Due to the drastic growth in aviation sector, population living standard and adverse effect of the Covid-19 pandemic there is an increase in air travel in the recent years. However, Indian airline corporation use revenue management system to make real-time price adjustments, causing fare to fluctuate considerably. The price is characterized by considerable fluctuation, making it viable to conduct research on price prediction. This issue is addressed in this work where flight fare prediction is carried out by implementing deep neural network system. Furthermore, the attributes of the given dataset have been analyzed using various visualization technique such as correlation matrix, boxplot, bar chart and line plot. The results justify that the random forest and the gradient boos technique gives highest accuracy with the fare prediction dataset.

articleTitle: A short review on recent models and requirements of antennas for 5G applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Wireless communication technology emerged as the potential means of communication in commercial and personal. Several other technologies like 5G and the Internet of Things (IoT) have co-evolved with good communication and rapid connectivity standards. This paper highlights the generations of mobile technology and the recent developments in techniques, tools, and the environment. In specific several antenna designing techniques, developments in the dimensions and geometry of the antenna are featured in the discussion to give a brief overview of several stages of mobile and wireless communication in the perceptive of antenna engineers

articleTitle: Execution of College Enquiry Chatbot using IBM virtual Assistant
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: From Pre-Primary schools to public and private universities, there are more choices now, than earlier for seeking education. Choosing best one to opt completely depends on certain entities of Organization like its Infrastructure, Faculty and its performance in previous academic years. In the present generation, students have many doubts regarding which college should be opted by them so that their career will be on a positive note and many more doubts once the college is opted regarding exams, schedule, contact details etc, and the selection of the college is done by verifying and validating the college entities. To know about the College, student adopts methods like approaching the college or enquiring on call or through emails. This can be useful for some particular queries but not worth for general queries. So in order to save time and to get relevant answers through less effort College Enquiry Chatbot can be implemented. Chatbot, a recent innovation, are reflections which can understand Natural Language of humans, process it and reply back by question answer capability and reduce time and effort for the questioning people and serve round the clock, on a simple note Chatbot are the replacement of humans to continue generalized quessianire through online. In our Paper we try to implement Chatbot which are developed and implemented using IBM virtual Assistant which is also called as IBM Watson.

articleTitle: A hybrid feature selection method using multi-objective Jaya algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Feature selection (FS) is a preprocessing procedure in machine learning that seeks to extract model predictors from a large geographic domain dataset to enhance prediction accuracy. They extract the most important features from a dataset and exclude those that could hinder estimation methods’ accuracy. However, as the number of observations grows, the dimensionality of the feature space grows, posing a considerable computational and prediction accuracy problem for numerous traditional feature selection approaches. In the context of software engineering, several feature selection strategies are studied. Normalized mutual information (NMI) and Jaya Algorithm are combined in this paper to create a hybrid feature selection algorithm. The proposed Normalized Mutual Information Jaya Algorithm (NMIJA) selection approach significantly decreases data dimension and minimizes classification redundancies. The reduced dataset achieves the highest classification accuracy when compared to typical feature selection algorithms. China, Desharnais, Kemer, and Maxwell are some of the datasets that were used. The numerical findings support the suggested model’s validity.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of MMC with Novel Multi-Carrier Phase Shifted Pulse Width Modulation (MCPS-PWM)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Modular multilevel converters are becoming the dominant converter in high voltage power ultra-high AC output voltage applications. When it comes to efficient power conversions, it has a lot of flexibility. Despite the fact that it transfers power at higher levels, switching losses are reduced since the converter uses fewer semiconductor components. In this study, three-, five-, and seven-level Modular Multilevel Converters (MMC) were investigated and developed using MATLAB/Simulink. For creating firing pulses, this work introduces novel Multicarrier Phase Shifted Pulse Width Modulation Techniques (MCPS-PWM). Using proposed MCPS-PWM, the performance of various levels in MMC like three-level, five-level, and seven -level was examined. Conventional multilevel converters like the cascaded H bridge (CHB), Flying Capacitor Clamped (FCC), and diode clamped (DC) multilevel converters are simulated and their percent THDs are compared to MMCs using the proposed MCPS-PWM.

Author Keywords: Multicarrier Phase Shifted Pulse Width Modulation Techniques (MCPS-PWM)

articleTitle: An Optimized Semi-blind Watermarking Technique for Digital Images using Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In this paper, Bat Algorithm (BA) is used to optimize the proposed semi-blind watermarking scheme of digital images to attain better imperceptibility and robustness. The insertion of the watermark is performed by normalized block processing (NBP) and hybrid transforms such as IWT, DCT and SVD. The embedding and extraction processes have been performed with the parameters obtained from the bat algorithm. The experimental results prove that this scheme exhibits very good perceptual quality for the watermarked image and better robustness for the watermark. The proposed approach is also superior to the other existing methods in terms of PSNR.

articleTitle: Wide Band Conformal Coplanar Benz Shaped Circular Ring Antenna for C and X Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: A Conformal Coplanar Benz Shaped Circular Ring (CBSCR) patch antenna operates in the upper C-band and X-band region with compact structure is presented in this work. Patch is etched on a polyimide substrate with dielectric constant 3.5 and height 0.8mm. The proposed ring antenna has compact size of 20x20 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is feed with coplanar waveguide which provides wide impedance bandwidth of 4.34GHz from 6.95GHz to 11. 29GHz with resonant frequency of 9.08GHz. CST Microwave Studio is used to design and simulate the proposed ring patch antenna. The simulation results show the return loss of -12dB, -20.34dB and -15.73dB at 7.5GHz, 9.08GHz and 9.8GHz with a gain of 2.36dBi, 2.46dBi and 2.52dBi respectively and the radiation efficiency is greater than 85% all over the operating band.

articleTitle: A Systematic Comparison of Approximate 4-2 Compressors for Efficient Approximate Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In a Digital Signal Processing (DSP) system, the multiplier is an essential element. It had given the large design parameters values in DSP systems, and hence efficient multipliers are now in high demand. Approximate Computing (ACG) has been used in exact multiplier design by lowering design parameter values. This paper, first, reviews the eighteen recent proposed 4-2 Approximate Compressors (ACs). Next, develop the Verilog code of eighteen 4-2 ACs and 8-bit Wallace Multiplier (WM) with these 4-2 ACs. Next, these 4-2 ACs and WM were then simulated and synthesized by Cadence RTL Compiler in a 90 nm CMOS standard library file. The results reveal that Liu2 provided the best design parameter values compared to WM with the remaining 4-2 ACs.

articleTitle: Adaptive Duty-Cycle Scheduling using Bi-Directional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) for Next Generation IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is a group of interconnected devices which contain sensors to collect useful data. Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques like Machine learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) are very much popular in many applications including IoT. The main goal of Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) is to perform more effective IoT functions, enhance the man-to-machine interactions and enhance the capacity for data management. In this paper, an adaptive duty-cycle scheduling using BiDirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) algorithm is proposed for IoT networks. In this algorithm, initially, the Jaccard Similarity Index (JSI) between two sensors are estimated. Then sensors with highest similarity (ie highest JSI values) are selected for sleep scheduling. Once the eligible sensors for sleep scheduling are selected based on the JSI values, their traffic loads and Energy levels are estimated from the previous traffic patterns using BiLSTM. The duty cycle of sensors are by estimated by adjusting the length of sleep duration according to the estimated traffic load and energy levels of the selected sensors. By experimental results, we show that the proposed BiLSTM-ADS technique achieves higher prediction accuracy and residual energy with lesser computational cost.

articleTitle: Multilevel Inverter Fed 1- Φ Asynchronous Motor Based Water Pumping System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Multilevel inverters (MLI) assisted water pumping system is gaining more popularity in various applications as it can be easily extended to the photovoltaic system which can used in the absence of main supply. In this paper the fifteen level MLI is used to test the performance of Induction Motor water pumping system using various PWM techniques. The switching sequence for the MLI is obtained using level shift pulse width modulation technique to reduce the total harmonic distortion. The entire system is executed using MATLAB and validated with experimental setup.

articleTitle: Identification of Facial Expressions Using Local Phase Quantization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Facial Expression takes non-verbal signals, shows a major part in social associations. The Face recognition arrangement remains route of finding expressive formal of a person. In this arrangement taken picture is related with accomplished data set available in data base and expressive formal of appearance will be presented. On behalf scheming a solid facial descriptor, we apply the Local Phase Quantization. It is a modest identical capable texture hand which makes the pixel of appearance by look back the quarter of individually pixel and reflects the outcome as a twin number. Histogram will be formed by using the operator label of Local Binary Patterns. The gratitude shows the planned technique drive be assessed by using the trained database.

articleTitle: High-Speed Vedic Multiplier Implementation Using Memristive and Speculative Adders
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In ALU’s, among accumulators and various other signal processing modules, the most significant operating block is multipliers. Due to the requirement of minimum delay, special importance is certain in designing faster multipliers. Among numerous multiplier designs, Vedic multipliers are ideal for their operational speed. Sixteen Vedic multiplication sutras are speed efficient in their way. The proposed “URDHVA TIRYAKBHYAM” is a technique which has been effective in terms of speed. Further, the performance of the Vedic multiplier is compared by employing different adders such as ripple carry adder, inexact speculative adder, IMPLY logic Memristive adder. The proposed Vedic multipliers improved in delay compared with the existing model. Parallel computation of partial products and summation is an added advantage in reducing the delay of the multiplier. Results of Vedic multiplier designs integrated with different adders are compared after simulating using the Xilinx Vivado tool.

articleTitle: Application of Convolutional Neural Networks on Insulation Status Prediction Using Partial discharges for Underground Cable Joints
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: This paper presents a deep learning methodology for predicting the insulation status of power cable joints using partial discharges (PD). The PD patterns are obtained from three different laboratory models representing three defect types in power cable joints. The PD data are obtained from a set of PD experiments with 14 high voltage cable joints which included prefabricated artificial defects. Phase-resolved partial discharge (PRPD) is employed for the feature extraction by identifying the PD data. The most popular format of PRPD, n-q-φ pattern in the form of optimal image format of all test samples is considered for training and testing the convolutional neural networks (CNNs) model. The validation accuracy obtained by CNN in this paper is 97.3%. The results show that the CNN model successfully predicts the insulation status stages as attention period, risky period and null period.

articleTitle: Implementation of mid-day meal scheme into limelight
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Today’s child is the citizen of tomorrow whose primary requirement is nutritional food, good education and grooming. The Mid-Day Meal Scheme (MDMS) was started to provide a cooked nutrition meal on every school day. The basic purpose of this scheme was to improve enrollment, retention and attendance of children in school and simultaneously improving nutritional levels among them. MDMS is the largest feeding program in the world and would be a successful scheme when it was implemented in a proper way. But that’s not happening now due to fraudulent activities are taking place in MDMS. Every year thousands of crores are being allocated for this scheme implementation. The greedy officers diverted hundreds of crores from the funds allocated for this scheme. Nutrition food supplies are also being diverted from reaching the students and are being in black markets. There are even cases of food poisoning. The proposed block-chain technology based MDMS will leave no scope for these activities. The proposed system makes traceability and accountability easy with minimal human intervention.

articleTitle: Cell Optimization and Realization of QCA flip flop
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Due to physical limitations in traditional transistor-based CMOS technology confronts as device dimensions shrink, such as in nano scale regimes, ultrathin door oxides, short channel effects, leakage streams, and high control utilization is only a few examples. As a competitor to conventional CMOS-based innovation, Quantum Dot Cellular Automata could be a modern quantum methodology that suggests an entirely discrete computational stage of planning, computerized rationale circuits utilizing quantum specks kept in a potential well to successfully prepare and transfer data at the nano scale. In this paper, we depicted the D, T, JK and SR flip flops. Here, the optimization of cells and the realisation of quantum cells are used for designing of flip flops. The functionality is verified by a QCA Designer tool and parameters such as the how many cells, space, latency and quantum costs are all taken into account. is better in comparison to already existing designs. The energy dissipations were estimated to set on the adaptability of the manufactured flip-flops.

articleTitle: Linearly Tapered Meandered Slot Flexible Antenna for DCS/ISM/WLAN/WiMAX Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: A flexible CPW-Fed linearly tapered meandered slot (LTMS) antenna is proposed for DCS/ISM/WLAN/ WiMAX Applications. Polyimide material is used as substrate to achieve flexibility. Linear tapering and meandered slot is considered in order to enhance the bandwidth and gain of the LTMS antenna. The LTMS antenna resonates at 2.28GHz (1.7-2.66GHz) and 5.58GHz (4.6-7.3GHz) multi-band frequencies with a -15.6dB and -35.1dB reflection coefficients respectively. The 3D-gains are observed 2.67dBi and 4.52dBi. In order to check the compatibility with flexible devices bending deformation is also checked with the proposed LTMS antenna. Very slight deviations are observed in antenna performance in bending state and the performance of the antenna will not be deviated with the planar state.

articleTitle: A Square Slotted Circular Patch MIMO Antenna with DGS for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Design of a multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) four-port ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna is presented. The antenna dimensions are 39 x39x1.6m$\text{m}^{3}$. It achieves multiband operation and wider bandwidth characteristics by embedding with four square-slotted circular patch (SCP) antennas with micro-strip fed line and rectangular slots added to each other for accomplishment of good isolation. Incorporation of Defected Ground Structure (DGS) resulted in improvement of antenna performance parameters like a number of frequency bands, bandwidth, and isolation making the antenna suitable for UWB applications. The proposed antenna is operating in two frequency bands 3.96 GHz – 6.12 GHz and 9.42 GHz – 20 GHz with 6.6 dBi peak gain. The proposed antenna achieved satisfactory MIMO characteristic parameters. The proposed antenna operates in C-band, X-band, Ku-band, and suitable for UWB applications.

articleTitle: Developments of Approximate Computing: From Algorithm Level to System Level
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Low power is one of the critical parameters in the Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) circuits design. In recent years, approximate computing techniques have improved the design metrics delay, area, and power or energy with a tradeoff inaccuracy. Computational intensive and error-tolerant applications are more suitable to adopt approximation Methods. Approximate computing is an emerging computing paradigm in low power VLSI design. It provides low power consumption at the cost of accuracy. This paper presents an introduction, applications, and developments in approximate computing.

articleTitle: Using Artificial Jellyfish Algorithm with Transformation Technique for Secure Video Watermarking Embedding Process
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Digital watermarking is seen as a potential technology for addressing a broad class of challenges in a digital era. In addition to copyright protection, other potential applications of digital watermarking include content authentication, distribution tracing, and tamper recovery. Nowadays, the majority of data are transferred in the form of digital photos or videos, which are relatively easy for infringements of exclusive rights to fake and then share for profit. As a result, digital watermarking emerged as a potential way to mention these infringements on exclusive rights. In this paper, we proposed the efficient and secure watermarking technique by using the Discrete Wavelet Transforms (DWT) technique and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), these are used for decomposition and swapping of original images. To enhance the DWT and SVD performance, the co-coefficients are optimally selected by using an Artificial Jellyfish Search Algorithm (AJS). In the embedding process, initially, the original videos are divided into several video frames, and then applied the proposed method process to the embedded watermarking process. The proposed model performs the encryption process by using the Elliptic-Curve Cryptography (ECC) technique. The main two themes as first swapped the text images with an original image and also embedded the greyscale image with a swapped image. The watermarked image is compressed by using H.265 video encoding algorithm to reduce the size of the video, which is most helpful for transmission

articleTitle: Implementation of Multiple Health Parameters Monitoring Using SoC’s
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Nowadays the need for monitoring of health has grown in the health care system. So here is a proposed system to monitor the health of comatose patients, Paralysis patients and the patients in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU). The patient is monitored based on certain parameters using Internet of Things. This system monitors health parameters such as temperature of the body, Oxygen levels, urine levels, Heart rate/pulse rate, shivering of patient’s body and ECG using respective sensors from the patient’s body for certain period of time. A sensor node here is Raspberry pi module and Arduino board with different sensors interfaced to it, which collects the data continuously from the patient’s body and sends it to the Cloud server. The sensors attached to patients body senses different parameters like heart rate, body temperature etc which forms a wireless body sensor network. This system is mainly to detect abnormal conditions in the human body and abnormal psychological parameters. If any abnormality is detected, an alert reaches the end monitoring device through the internet.

articleTitle: Impact of Critical Success Factors in Oracle EBS Enterprise Resource Planning Post Go Live Implementation:A Case Study on SriLankan Airlines
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In today’s business world, ERP does everything from recording transaction data, managing workflows, analyzing data to provide insights to decision makers for effective decision making. Selection of a right ERP, proper testing and post go live could be a major scale system implementation for any organization. Thus, it is extremely beneficial to evaluate and test the Critical Success Factors (CSFs) in order to ensure a successful ERP post go live implementation. The primary goal of this study is to determine the impact of Critical Success Factors that influence for a successful post go live ERP implementation in the context of the national airline of Sri Lanka which is SriLankan Airlines. Three critical success factors were identified through this study. This study aims on Adequate end user training, Business Process Management (BPM) and Top Management Support as CSFs. The findings have verified that the ERP implementation success is influenced by the Top Management Support, Business Process Management and adequate end user trainings. Out of the identified three CSFs, it is statistically proven that the adequate end user training takes a significantly prominent place for a successful post go live implementation while BPM and Top Management Support also equally contribute to drive an ERP implementation project with expected outcomes. This study could be a guidance for enterprises, be beneficial to ERP clienteles, ERP consultants and service providers, be added to the existing body of knowledge.

articleTitle: Textual Sentimental Classification using Convolution Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Sentiment analysis on classification of text data is one of the emerging tasks in natural language processing compared to others. In the main, there is a need for big dig for meaningful information from the data present on the internet through sentiment analysis. Deep learning has already been successful in keeping up with sentiment analysis tasks utilizing deep learning models. Nowadays, client happiness is the most crucial factor for every mature firm. As a result, many businesses live and promote their products and services on social media platforms, where they eventually receive evaluations and feedback from their customers. Studying each word and phrase one at a time is time-consuming. Thus, evaluating the sentiment of all texts provides organizations with an overview of how positive and negative users are on a given issue. In this study, we investigated word embedding architecture utilizing the convolutional neural network algorithm or approach (CNN). We created a convolutional neural network architecture using a continuous loop of the tensor flow technique, along with word2vec and evaluated the outcome by using the measures accuracy, precision, recall, and f1-scoring. It reaches an accuracy of more than 92 percent, significantly boosting text categorization accuracy.

articleTitle: Battery and Supercapacitor Performance Analysis during Regenerative Braking in Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In mechanical braking, the kinetic energy is converted into heat losses. The system efficiency can be increased if this kinetic energy is recovered and reused. The regenerative braking in electric vehicles recovers this heat loss as electrical energy is restored in the battery, supercapacitors, or flywheel. The mathematical analysis of battery and supercapacitor is studied in this article. The performance of battery and supercapacitors during regenerative braking is presented. The characteristics of this regenerative braking process were studied using MATLAB/SIMULINK environment.

articleTitle: Channel Distribution in Cognitive Radio Network Using MIMO
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: The mass volume and different information produced by Smart network applications need utilization of Cognitive Radio innovation for efficient taking care of. In this we have studied about the task of range to the optional clients when essential client are not utilizing. The work utilizes a crossover of cognitive radio and MIMO change with collecting of passages, the channel distribution is finished by taking the real time climate into thought. In this paper, 3 task plans are offered fair -MIMO plot, priority-MIMO plan and small cluster-MIMO. Here, fair-MIMO is utilized in low rush hour state when every HGW send the occasional information. The priority-MIMO as opposed to saving channels for needed client’s places non-need clients in a cradle in conditions when no empty channel is free for needed clients, this plan is utilized in average rush hour gridlock situation. For the high-rise in traffic burden, CC-MIMO gives need as well as furthermore acquires channels from close by entryways. The count of channel allotments and extreme total prizes are reenacted regarding the count of clients in presence of needed clients.

articleTitle: High Efficiency and Wideband Power Amplifier Design for 5G Communication System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: This paper introduces the design of wideband Power Amplifier (PA) biased in class AB configuration operating at 3.3 to 4.3 GHz frequency band for 5G base station applications. The PA is designed using active device CGH40010 manufactured by Cree Inc. with broadband matching networks that leads to enhanced performance of PA. The detailed step by step methodology along with full layout is presented in this paper. The EM co-simulation is carried out of proposed PA which achieves the peak DE is the range from 68 % to 80 % along with more than 15 dB gain for entire frequency band. Additionally, the peak output power is ranging between 40.5 dBm to 42.2 dBm.

articleTitle: Shock Filtering based Additive White Gaussian Noise Removal in Radiographic Scans
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Image processing techniques play crucial role in medical applications especially in diagnosis of ailments and diseases. The obtained images have to be segmented and carefully analysed to diagnose the minor as well as serious ailments. Therefore, noise suppression in the medical images becomes crucial. In this paper, Shock Filter is implemented to denoise the medical images. The method proposed in this paper uses Shock Filter to diffuse the noisy part of the image while preserving the details of the original image. Shock filter deploys the morphological operators and aids in edge enhancement and segmentation of Image. In addition to implementation of proposed method, experimental analysis is discussed to claim the efficiency of method based on parameters like PSNR etc.

articleTitle: A Birdsong Denoising using Cascaded Combination of Phase Spectrum Compensation and Wavelets
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Automatic bird call recording and analysis is becoming an effective way of understanding changes in bird population and determining the health of the environment. The behavioral and ecological studies could benefit for identifying species from acoustic recordings. Noise interference that can mask vocalizations of interest is presently troublesome with the automated analysis of bird recordings. Therefore, noise reduction will significantly improve the accuracy of automated analyses and minimize processing work for later phases in bioacoustics. One major obstacle to achieve this noise reduction is the low level of signal-to-noise ratios in unsupervised recordings. In addition, the field recordings of birdsong are also very noisy incorporating ambient noise, activities related to humans and other species, along with noise from the recorder itself. Signal processing is needed to suppress the background noise and enhance the target bird call. So far, some traditional enhancement filters are used. However, their effectiveness is not good for all types of bird spices in bird recordings. We proposed a technique of denoising that used a cascaded combination of wavelet denoising and Phase Spectrum Compensation (PSC). An objective measure of speech quality, time domain and spectrogram analysis using real data clearly, shows that the proposed combination PSC-Wavelet perform well over the individual algorithms resulting in improved quality over natural noisy bird recordings.

articleTitle: PAPR Analysis of MB-OFDM UWB Signal using Hybrid PS-GW optimized PTS Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Multiband Orthogonal Frequency Division multiplexing Ultra-Wideband (MB-OFDM UWB) is famous and striking stratagem used in wireless communication for massive broadcast of data with greater rate was approach is used. However, like OFDM, major problem identified in MB-OFDM UWB system is high PAPR. “Partial Transmit Sequences” (PTS) is acquainted approaches to decrease PAPR in OFDM since this doesn’t give distortion in the signal. A hybrid optimization algorithm called PS-GW is used along with PTS to lessen PAPR for MB-OFDM UWB is considered in this article. A best mixture of phase turning factors is attained from PS-GW algorithm. PS-GW is a hybrid of “Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO)” and “Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO)”. The results of this proposed method show that PAPR was reduced, and computing complexity was effectively reduced.

articleTitle: A Nucleus Based Feature Extraction From Histopathology Images Using CNN For Liver Cancer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: The process of evaluating a surgical tissue specimen is known as histopathology. For preservation, tissue is fixed and placed on glass slides with chemicals. Whole slide imaging WSI) is the process or scanning conventional glass slides in order to produce digital slides, WSI continues to gain attraction among pathologists for diagnostic, educational, and research purposes. A WSI contains more than 100,000 pixels in any spatial dimension. Feature extraction plays an important role in the diagnosis of cancer using computer-aided methods. Various machine learning methodologies is introduced to extract features from WSI images. These approaches ignore to extract the large scale architectural relationships present in the nucleus. Nucleus in the WSI contains enormous information. For histopathology images, a nucleus-based feature extraction utilising a Convolutional neural network is proposed in this study. Initially the nucleus is detected from images which is then used in training a neural network. This helps in extracting macro and micro image level information like the spatial distribution and pattern. The extracted features are valuated using the classification approaches on a histopathology database of liver tumour. The results show a better classification performance for liver tumour when comparing other methods.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of OMP Hybrid Beamforming Algorithm for OFDM millimeter Wave MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Upcoming wireless communication services like concept of autonomous vehicles, connected vehicles, smart cities, Internet of Things and augmented reality will revolutionize the society. During the deployment of these services and their applications, around 60 billion connected devices are anticipated for provide services to the society in the near future. Hybrid beamforming techniques for massive MIMO systems is perceived as one of the key technologies to enhance system capacity. This paper, performance analysis of most referred OMP based hybrid beamforming Algorithm for a variety of MIMO schemes is presented. The trade-off between spectral efficiency and dimensions of antenna arrays is also presented for wideband OFDM millimeter wave massive MIMO environment.

articleTitle: Cross-layer approach to enhance the Energy efficiency, QoS performance and minimize the data dropped during mobility in Zigbee based Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are revolutionizing the Internet of Things (IoT), including many sensor nodes connected. Energy efficiency, Battery life, data dropped, QoS, memory, mobility, and computational capacity are significant challenges in Wireless Sensor Networks. Because data is frequently lost due to mobility, it will impact the completeness and quality of information (QoI). It will increase the delay, media access delay, load that hinders the network performance. The main objective is to minimize the data dropped and enhance the energy efficiency, QoS performance by considering IEEE 802.15.4, Zigbee protocol. This paper proposes a cross-layer (CL) approach based on MAC and Physical layers with design considerations by optimizing the parameters. OPNET 14.5 Modeler used to carry out the work for this research. According to the simulation results, the proposed cross-layer approach is more efficient than the traditional approach regarding the Throughput, Delay, Media Access Delay, Load, Data dropped.

articleTitle: Biological Impacts of MRI Examinations of Different Ratings on Human Tissue
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: MRI assessment is normally named as MRI. An MRI, which utilizes magnets and a PC to take snaps of the internal piece of our body with different MRI rating machines (ranges 0.5 Tesla to 24 Tesla), is surveyed here. Each snap shows just a couple of layers of body tissue at once. The clarity and pixels of snaps increases as the rating of machines goes up i.e., 3 Tesla machine scan is more informatics compared to 0.5 Tesla machine and so on. This paper discusses in review about the organic impacts of magnetic and electromagnetic fields ordinarily utilized in MRI examination after a presentation of the electromagnetic properties of the human tissue, the fundamental marvels to comprehend the bio-impacts are portrayed in old-style terms. The response of the biological tissues towards such strong mechanism is powerful and fields of MRIs of different ratings are assessed and analyzed at different levels.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of HIRA for Hardening of Critical Facilities against IEMI
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In this paper, design, and Simulation analysis of Half Impulse Radiating Antenna (HIRA) for Hardening of Military and Civilian Establishments from Intentional Electromagnetic Interference (IEMI) was carried out. IEMI is the act of intentionally generating a transient electromagnetic short pulse which has very high intensity peak values that are used to disrupt the electronic and electrical equipment operation. To produce a high intensity, fast rise time, short pulses (UWB signal) which covers a wide range of frequencies, a specific type of antenna is required. One such promising antenna would be HIRA. The HIRA is a transient antenna that take transient voltage as input and radiate Ultra-Wideband (UWB) electromagnetic field signals. Defence Critical Infrastructure need to be protected against Intentional transient Electromagnetic pulses. High Level of protection for IEMI will be done by hardening the electronic systems using electromagnetic barrier with different architectural Point of Entries (PoE) treatments. In this Paper, IEMI hardening of RF enclosure with different architectural PoE’s carried out by evaluating its Shielding Effectiveness (SE) using 3D EM simulation and Practical measurements.

articleTitle: Circular Patch Antenna with Rectangular Slots and DGS for UWB and Multiband Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: A Circular patch antenna with rectangular slots (CPRS) and Defected Ground Structure (DGS) is presented in this paper. The even and uneven rectangular slot areas are considered. Better performance is obtained for the antenna with even slot areas. The CPRS antenna is a multiband antenna operating in three frequency bands with a bandwidth of 350 MHz (11.02 GHz – 11.37 GHz), 1.07 GHz (13.64 GHz – 14.71 GHz), and 1.54 GHz (17.59 GHz – 19.13 GHz) with 6 dBi peak gain. Adding DGS improves the bandwidth and gain making the antenna useful for UWB applications. With the introduction of DGS to the proposed CPRS antenna, frequency bandwidth of 3.10 GHz (4.98 GHz – 8.08 GHz) and 8.51 GHz (11.49 GHz – 20 GHz) with 6.9 dBi peak gain is obtained.

articleTitle: Fish Feeding Boat using BLDC Motor for Aqua Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Fish are supplied by weight in aquaculture industry. The fish must swim in order to gain weight when meal is supplied, which is tossed at various spots throughout the pond. The issue is how to disperse fishmeal throughout the pond and create a system that allows the fish to travel across the pond and gain maximum bodyweight. The system consists primarily of a boat with an integrated container for loading fish feed. To drive the boat BLDC motor is used due its numerous advantages than other motors. Supply to the motor is taken through batteries and converted in to required form with the help of BLDC controller. This paper showcases the design of low cost high efficient BLDC motor based aerator float for fish feeding in aquaculture.

articleTitle: Cost Efficient Design Of Error Detection Circuit For Nano Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In this paper, a cost-efficient error detection circuit is designed using Quantum Dot Cellular Automata (QCA) for Nano communication with a lower number of QCA Cells. Parity generation and detection are used to ensure that the message sent to the recipient is error-free. The suggested parity generator and checker are designed with a newly designed XOR gate which has 10.9% and 68% fewer cells, respectively, than the existing designs. The area is decreased by 16% for the parity generator and 25% for the parity checker, which is better when compared with previous layouts. Due to this improved quantum cost and area, it is more accurate to use these circuits in nano communication in order to achieve more efficient, error-free data. With the use of the QCA Designer simulation tool, 4 bit and 8 bit parity generators and parity checkers are designed and verified in order to examine the correctness of the circuit so that it can be used in error detection applications in nano technology.

articleTitle: Graphene based Tunable Band stop Filter using T-shape Resonator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In this paper, a narrowband band stop filter with graphene is designed. The filter is designed by using a T-shaped resonator which is coupled to the transmission line. In the filter design, Graphene layers are placed at the metal dielectric interface to support the propagation of surface plasmonic wave’s transmission. The proposed filter has shown good resonant characteristics at 0.88 THz by using Finite Integration technique. By modifying the number of layers of graphene, the center frequency of the proposed bandstop filter is tuned from 0. 88THz to 0. 89THz with constant absolute bandwidth of 50 GHz. From the results it is apparent that the stopband response is obtained with a good attenuation of about -25dB in stopband.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection and Repellent System for Wild Animals Using Artificial Intelligence of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: A prominent conflict observed between growing masses and wildlife in India. Few of the major consequences are: Injury, loss of life, damage to human property, crop damage, destruction of human habitats and many more. Adaption of temporary solutions like electric fences, trenches, manual surveillance, guard dogs, etc. are used to protect the habitat but are not economic and proven to stay as an unsafe solution for wildlife as well the humans. In order to initiate safety for both wild animals and humans, some mitigation plan is required to solve this issue. While there are various IoT-based Animal Surveillance and repellent systems in market, a touch of Artificial Intelligence can make it more reliable and efficient. This will certainly push forward the bars that are kept limited with the use of IoT alone. The proposed system aims in protecting human habitation and livestock at the outskirts of the forest area/ fields by developing an automated system that detects the intrusion of wild animals and repels them back to the forest without causing any harm; Hence minimizing the dangerous consequences caused by the Human-Wildlife conflict.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach for Sentiment Analysis using Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Last few years have delivered a huge boom in the field of research in Sentiment Analysis, totally on incredibly subjective textual content kinds like films or products evaluations. This research work design a feature selection technique with Bagged Random Forest classification to predict the sentiments of news articles. This work represents comparison among C4. 5, random forest algorithm, bagged random forest algorithm and proposed algorithm by taking various parameters into consideration. Results are evaluated on the basis of various attributes namely correctly classified instances, incorrectly classified instances, error comparison. The basis of this comparison was done by taking various parameters into light such as mean absolute error, root mean squared error, relative absolute error, root relative squared error, average true positive rate, average false positive rate, recall and F-measure. These new results have proved that the proposed technique is having better results than the previous one.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Technique with Spider Monkey Optimization for COVID-19 Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: The coronavirus (COVID-19) has unquestionably posed one of the most difficult problems in human history. As of May 5, 2021, the global death toll from the on going COVID-19 epidemic was at 150 million. Monitoring, managing, and finally eradicating the disease can be made easier by understanding the mood represented in people’s social media remarks. It is the goal of this research to educate social media policy, such as how much reasonableness is required to curb misrepresentation on social media. This research also examines people’s opinions on COVID-19 over social media sharing and interaction on Twitter. For our studies, we’ve generated a new large-scale sentiment data collection called COVIDSENTI that includes 90,000 tweets about the COVID-19 epidemic from February to March of the following year. We classified the tweets based on their emotional tone: good, negative, or neutral. In this work, ensemble machine learning classifier and uses the Spider Monkey optimization (SMO) for selecting the optimal features. The raw datasets are cleaned by using pre-processing techniques and important features are extracted by using feature extraction practises. We used multiple parameter measurements to assess the gathered tweets for sentiment categorization.

articleTitle: Student Cognitive Learning Capability (SCLC) Prediction System using PCA-ANN based Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Educational institutions and education system play the important role in any society or country for development in all aspects like agriculture, industrial, economic and political. Teaching methodologies, learning preferences and techniques, socio-economics decide the student learning capabilities. Cognitive Learning (CL) is a kind of learning that is constructive, active, durable, and productive. It employs educates in the learning measures, encouraging them to think effectively to make connections when learning new things. In this paper, we want to demonstrate the student learning capabilities using their cognitive abilities. For this, we demeanor training and examines on different cognitive abilities and also collect the personal and other factors which impact student learning. In this process, we conduct training and examine the 313 engineering educates from AITAM Eng. College, A.P., India. We apply the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) algorithm for feature selection, and for prediction, use the ANN with back-propagation algorithm. The Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model is constructed, as that the hidden layer of ANN neurons initially is two, after that we increment the neurons by one until reach good accurate results. The 5-neurons HL ANN is performed well as per performance parameters like accuracy (100%), AUC (1), R-value (1), recall, and precisions values.

articleTitle: ResNet Model to Forecast Plant Leaf Disease
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Agriculture is a significant part of a developing country like India, and agricultural intervention is essential in rural livelihood. As per the statistical measurement, 65% of the Indian economy is dependent on agriculture and farming. On the other hand, various plant diseases hugely affect most crops. In this concern, the farmer needs an effective plant leaf disease analysis model to detect plant illness in the early stages to moderate the criticality and prevent severe losses in crop growth, quantity and production etc. In this regard, it is possible to mention that the plant leaf disease identification methods play a major role in protecting plants. Researchers are working to analyze the plant diseases by using recognized classifying techniques. Supportive, deep learning and Image processing are the leading cutting-edge technologies used to address these challenges. This work uses the Resnet 152 v2 model on a data set containing 7000 plant leaf pictures. The model achieved 95% accuracy which is better than many previous models discussed in the literature.

articleTitle: Prediction of Human Suicidal Tendency based on Social Media using Recurrent Neural Networks through LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Suicida1 Tendency Prediction utilizing data from Social Media is a recent factor that influences suicide-related event behavior. Suicide is the world’s eleventh leading cause of death, according to the World Health organization (WHO). Suicide identification is influenced by societal and environmental factors as well as individual factors. Suicide has recently become a ‘social’ menace. Twitter is rapidly being explored as a source that shows and detects a person’s psychological status. The goal of this work is to check if tweets about suicides can be categorized based on their content. This is accomplished through the repetitive application of deep learning and machine learning algorithms, as well as the involvement of coders. Twitter data has been scrutinized for a series of suicide words and remarks using the public API. Suicide related tweets are gathered using keywords connected to suicide and saved in a CSV file, which serves as the dataset. A recursive neural network is then used to classify these tweets in order to determine whether or not a suicide can take place. The proposed model identifies users who have a proclivity for suicide, allowing them to be approached and referred for psychiatric care, thereby benefiting them and potentially saving their lives.

articleTitle: Weather Foreseeing using several methodologies of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Weather prediction is the major challenges. Weather predictions play a vital role in our daily life and it also affect the wealth of a nation. These are necessary in the initial level so that the next consequences of natural disasters can be predicted and the loss can be avoided. Machine Learning techniques are used to predict the temperature preciseness based on input features like previous values of temperature(T), relative humidity(RH), solar radiation(SR), rain along with wind speed, and many other measurements. Our goal is to apply weather data to different algorithms available in machine learning and compare the accuracy of classifiers such as SVM, Naive Bayes, K-nearest, Random Forest and Decision tree. Getting optimized result is the main motive of this paper and to forecast the weather precisely.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Technology in Healthcare: An Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Blockchain technology was first used in Bitcoin, as the underlying concept It has also been widely applied in many other sectors, such as healthcare, fmance, etc. In the healthcare domain, this technology keeps patients’ data secure, verifying healthcare products for their authenticity, maintaining the drugs supply chain, etc. For diagnosing disease and its treatment at remote places, the concept of blockchain has been added with telehealth and telemedicine. This paper discusses the application of blockchain technology in healthcare, especially Electronic Health Records (EHRs), Supply Chain Management, Telehealth, and Mobile-based Healthcare (mHealth). This work also discusses the comparative analysis of different published papers on healthcare and its limitations.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis on Frequency Control in an Autonomous Microgrid Using Adaptive Optimized Fuzzy Controllers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: This paper addresses an adaptive fuzzy logic controller for frequency control in an autonomous Microgrid based on the Jaya Algorithm optimization. Renewable Energy Sources (RESs) such as wind turbines (WTG) and solar pv (SPV), both of which have a high degree of nonlinearity, have been suggested as instantaneous Load Frequency Control (LFC) Sources during system frequency disturbances. Diesel generators (DEGs), fuel cells (FCs), and battery energy storage systems (BESS) have also been proposed. Extremely intermittent power from RESs, along with demand and system perturbations, causes huge frequency fluctuations in an autonomous Microgrid (MG). The use of adaptive Fuzzy logic controller (AFLC) for secondary frequency control was proposed in this paper. Scale parameters are tuned in real-time as operational parameters in the propose controller fuzzy input and output membership functions using the Jaya algorithm. Finally, the proposed controller's supremacy is demonstrated by comparing the results to those of other controllers presented in the literature. To compare the superiority of the proposed controller, PI, Fuzzy-PI and a PSO tuned Fuzzy-PI are used. The comparison is based on several performance indicators, particularly how the proposed controller improves dynamic responses. In MATLAB/Simulink, the proposed controller is implemented.

articleTitle: A Prediction of breast cancer based on Mayfly Optimized CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: Breast cancer patients are prone to major problems of greater mortality related to their health. Breast cancer diagnosis is time demanding, and a system that can automatically diagnose breast cancer in its early stage has to be developed due to the low availability of systems. The principal explanation may be that radiologists are misinterpreting suspected injuries due to technical difficulties in picture properties and diverse breast densities, hence increasing the false ratio. Timely intervention is important in developing an upto-date forecasting method that can reduce disease complications with increased recovery. For the categorization of benign and malignant tumours, various Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) algorithms were applied. However the detection by typical machine learning methods of breast abnormalities misinterprets an inconsistent feature extraction process that causes problems, the call-back to patients for biopsies to eradicate suspicions. Deep learning approaches for a reliable pronostic and categorization of breast cancer have therefore been developed. This research study focuses on the prediction of breast cancer using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The input images are removed by noises and segmentation is carried out by Otsu Thresholding technique. After that, CNNis applied for final prediction, where the learning rate of the CNN is optimized by using Mayfly Algorithm. The experiments are validated to test the efficiency of proposed CNN and proved that it achieved 97% of accuracy for the publicly available dataset.

articleTitle: Uses of data science and sensors in IoT smart agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of interconnected devices that can communicate data and operate activities without the need for human intervention. Agriculture provides a rich source of data for data analysis, which assists in the development of agricultural output. In smart farming, the usage of Internet of Things (IoT) devices assists in the modernization of information and communication. In agriculture, using Internet-of-Things (IoT) technology can reduce labor costs while also increasing output and efficiency. Data such as brightness, temperature, humidity, PH value, and so on may be collected using IoT technology to analyse and manage facilities. In this paper, we defined various data analytics and sensors used in IoT smart agriculture that enhances the productivity and crop health in-turn enables remote sensing and agricultural monitoring in assessment of weather condition, soil and air quality. This may enhance overall yield of agriculture and increase number of individuals involved in Agricultural process.

articleTitle: Predicting Earthquake by using GPS Seismology and GNSS Based System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)

authors.preferredName: K S V L N. Swamy

abstract: In this world, most dangerous natural disasters are Earthquake and Tsunamis. It has been significant threat to all living beings as per the records of existing data. Global Navigation Satellite Systems Receivers (GNSSR) are primary equipment for measuring the signatures linked with Earthquake and Tsunami hazards. GPS Receivers, Consequent Seismic Deformation Measurement (CSDM), Real-time GPS-derived Ocean buoy location estimations, and Co-seismic Vertical Displacements are some of the measured signs. These normal disasters magnitude is the significant factor to be determined accurately and rapidly. Especially large Earthquake magnitudes (M>8) measurement be supposed to be reliable and rapid. This magnitude is measured by GPS displacement waveform the natural-hazard-induced ionospheric disturbance remote sensing from GNSS could be applied and used in early warning systems for operational tsunamis and earthquakes.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Cryptographic Algorithm for securing medical data in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In the past few years, the researchers focused on cloud computing security, because of medical data usage and its importance. Therefore, data security on medical data is an important issue, while storing it on clouds. Decentralized protection safeguarding prescient displaying enables numerous organisations to learn about a more generalize on medical services or genomic information by sharing the halfway prepared models rather than patient-level information, while evading dangers, such as single-purpose of control. One of the most important aspects of human life has become restorative care, which has led to a dramatic increase in therapeutic data. Although these advancements pose serious security risks and concerns about the movement of information, they also raise serious concerns about data tracking and recording. Even if the patient’s life is in jeopardy, these security and protection issues of medical information could result from a delay in treatment. A high level of data transit and storage security can be achieved through the use of cryptography. Traditional symmetric and asymmetric have various drawbacks in terms of their design. In order to ensure the privacy and data security at high level, the research work implemented the new hybrid technique. Elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) and the SHA-256 Cryptographic Hash Algorithm (SHA-256) are being combined in this article to create a hybrid algorithm. Proposed methods for patient data security and confidentiality have been tested and the results proves that it outperforms existing methods. To overcome the drawbacks of both symmetric and asymmetric cryptography, hybrid cryptography is employed.

articleTitle: DFIG HVDC based wind farms system profile improvement under grid faults
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Communication and Power Technology (IC3P)
abstract: In this paper, Wind turbine driven Doubly-Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) is connected to a High Voltage DC grid (HVDC) and the system performance is observed under grid asymmetrical single Line-Ground (LG) faults. The DFIG converters control outer control loops are used in the lookup table-based demagnetization process to meet the active and reactive power flow under normal and abnormal conditions. The reactive power flow by the DFIG is adjusted to meet the stator terminal voltage change during the grid faults. Furthermore, using the DFIG’s fast acting inner rotor and grid side converter (RSC and GSC) control loops With the flux demagnetization technique, effective performance enhancement is envisaged. Since the converters are rated only to 30% of the stator terminal, complete surge current and machine and grid parameters improvement is done With a STATCOM compensator. The overall system performance is observed With the proposed scheme Without and With STATCOM under MATLAB/ SIMULINK environment. The HVDC terminals voltage and current and the DFIG parameters like speed, torque and various terminal voltages and current are observed for the analysis.

Author Keywords: Voltage Source Converter high voltage dc transmission (HVDC)
